ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between low-intensity dark perimeter/speckling and high-intensity yellowish-white central field; approximate 25:75 dark-to-light pixel distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense distribution of small, dark, circular high-contrast blobs (mottling) across the high-intensity background; concentrated dark banding along the trailing edge and a dark vertical cluster at the peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a central convergence; depth-to-width ratio is approximately 1:2.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations; jagged peaks and valleys (5-20 pixel amplitude) occur continuously along the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory from the median notch to the outer tips, terminating in jagged, upward-sweeping points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive detection of dark, roughly circular pixel clusters corresponding to localized surface interruptions; highest density observed on the upper-right lobe and along the trailing margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, high-intensity (white) linear pixel disruptions visible on the left lobe, cutting through the darker mottling pattern.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue profiles at both distal tips; heavy accumulation of dark, textured mass (parasitic or mineralized clusters) along the trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-tan pixel hue across the primary high-intensity regions of the ventral surface.
